price_source: historical prc_hicp_midx, CP00, I15, unadjusted; no splice
controls: lags 1 to p of policy contribution divided by shock_scale_pp
lags 1 to p of information contribution divided by shock_scale_pp
sample_rules: Complete current components, lagged controls and positive D/N at t-1 and t+h; no imputation or primary pandemic exclusions; future HICP/shocks not required.
primary_target: delta=gamma-beta_m: recomposed rate-surprise coefficient less policy-component coefficient on identical rows and controls
estimation: Full OLS Y~m+c+Z; reduced OLS Y~r+Z with r=m+c; weight OLS c~r+Z; QR with explicit full-rank checks
hac_kernel: Bartlett: 1-l/(L+1) at actual integer calendar-month distance l
finite_sample_adjustment: One common n/(n-k_full) multiplier for the complete joint influence covariance
primary_interval: 95 per cent conservative product bounds from a Bonferroni joint rectangle for (w,theta): each coordinate uses z_(0.9875); take four endpoint products
reported_intervals: 95 per cent asymptotic normal pointwise intervals for contextual coefficients and the regular stacked-score gap, separately labelled; no response-path simultaneous claim
uncertainty_scope: Random-regressor projection uncertainty conditional on the supplied factor, median rotation, source vintage and specification; not construction or identification-set uncertainty
robustness: six lags on the unchanged primary rows
poor-man components on the unchanged primary rows
pre-pandemic outcomes ending by 2019-12: origins 2000-01 to 2018-12 at h=12
short bandwidth L=h+ceil(B/2) and long L=h+2*B, unchanged primary coefficients
diagnostics: scaled condition numbers and residual shock variation
exact sample mixture and joint influence identities
single-origin deletion coefficient influence without automatic exclusions
verification: Selected estimates, samples, covariance and intervals independently reconstructed in base R
deviations: Retain this record unchanged; explain later specification departures in the paper appendix and a dated research record.
primary_hypothesis: Two-sided delta=0; the conservative primary interval is not a joint interval for all reported response coefficients.
regularity: Valid orthogonality and stable weakly dependent score moments, finite higher moments, full design rank and nondegenerate scalar long-run variances for w and theta; no guarantee of finite-sample coverage.
